_comment: Read by scripts/checks/check-npm-audit.mjs for both CI audit steps. The production step (--omit-dev) honours only entries with scope "production", and requires their "nodes" to equal the install paths npm audit reports. Only for advisories with no fixed version to move to. Policy: docs/security/vulnerability-triage.md.

suppressions.reason: No fixed version: every release through 4.0.7 is affected, and the advisory needs an attacker-supplied glob PATTERN (e.g. +(*)). The production-tree copies arrive only through build-time plugins: @sentry/nextjs's webpack wrapping loader (via @rollup/plugin-commonjs and @rollup/pluginutils) and next-intl's catalog extractor (via @parcel/watcher), which next.config.ts does not enable; none is in the standalone server output. That output's only copy is next's vendored dist/compiled/picomatch, which compiles images.localPatterns/remotePatterns; next.config.ts sets neither, so the one pattern is Next's built-in default '**' (next/dist/server/config.js), and a request supplies only the string matched against it. The dev-tree copies (vite, vitest, tinyglobby, micromatch via patch-package) compile globs from this repository's config, tests and package.json only.
